The lake at the heart of Our Lord's mini: Iria rĩrĩa rĩrĩ ngoro-inĩ ya wĩra wa Mwathani witũ, kũrĩa Atũmwo maagũragia thamaki na kũrĩa aahoreririe rũhuho na makũmbĩ.
Bir Ya'qub, Nablus (ancient Sychar): Gĩthima kĩa Jakubu, Nablus (Sukari wa tene)
One of the most securely identified plac: Kũndũ kũmwe kwa Ivanjeli kũrĩa kũmenyekaine mũno: gĩthima kĩrĩa Jakubu eenjire, rĩu kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa kanitha wa Ngiriki Orthodox rungu rwa kĩrĩma kĩa Gerizimu.
Church of the Beatitudes, above Tabgha: Kanitha wa Irathimo, igũrũ rĩa Tabgha
Matthew says only that He \"went up the: Mathayo oigaga o atĩ "nĩ aambatire kĩrĩma-inĩ" (Matthew 5:1). Karĩma karĩa karĩ igũrũ rĩa Tabgha nĩ gatĩĩtwo kuuma karine ka kana; kanitha wa ũmũthĩ ũrĩ na mĩena ĩnana, nĩ ũndũ wa Irathimo inyanya.
Nein, south of Mount Tabor: Nein, gũthini wa kĩrĩma kĩa Taboro
A small village on the slope of the Hill: Itũũra inini mwena wa kĩrĩma kĩa More. Kanitha mũnini wa Afransiskani nĩ ũronania harĩa Mwathani witũ aacemanirie na arĩa maakuuĩte kĩimba.
Church of Saint Anne, Old City of Jerusa: Kanitha wa Mũtheru Ana, Itũũra Inene rĩa Tene rĩa Jerusalemu
Archaeologists have uncovered the pool w: Athuthurie a maũndũ ma tene nĩ moonire karia karĩ na ciĩhumbĩro ithano hakuhĩ na Kanitha wa Mũtheru Ana, ũrĩa ũtĩĩtwo ta harĩa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria aaciarĩirwo.
Kursi, on the eastern shore of the Sea o: Kursi, hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia irathĩro cia Iria rĩa Galili
Mark and Luke say \"the territory of the: Mariko na Luka moigaga "bũrũri wa Agerasi", Mathayo "bũrũri wa Agadara". Nyũmba ya amonaki ya Bizantini ya tene kũu Kursi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia irathĩro nĩ ĩronania kũndũ kũrĩa kũmenyekaine.
Luke sets the feeding near Bethsaida (Lu: Luka oigaga atĩ kũrĩithia kĩrĩndĩ gwekĩkire hakuhĩ na Bethisaida (Luke 9:10). Kuuma karine ka kana, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ maririkanaga ũndũ ũcio kũu Tabgha, kũrĩa mbica ĩrĩa ĩmenyekaine mũno ya mĩgate na thamaki ĩrĩ mbere ya kĩgongona.
The Phoenician coast north of Galilee, t: Hũgũrũrũ cia Foinike mwena wa rũgongo wa Galili; rũgendo o rũmwe Mwathani witũ aathiire nja ya bũrũri wa Isiraeli hĩndĩ ya wĩra wake.
Hippos (Sussita), above the eastern shor: Hippos (Sussita), igũrũ rĩa hũgũrũrũ cia irathĩro
Mark says He went \"into the district of: Mariko oigaga atĩ aahĩtũkĩire "gatagatĩ ka bũrũri wa Dekapoli" (Mark 7:31), ngwatanĩro ya matũũra ma Ngiriki mwena wa irathĩro wa iria. Gũtiugĩtwo kũndũ kũrĩa kũna ciama icio ciekĩkire; Hippos, itũũra rĩa Dekapoli rĩrĩa rĩrĩ hakuhĩ mũno na iria, nĩrĩo rĩrũgamĩrĩire bũrũri ũcio haha.
Matthew writes Magadan, Mark Dalmanutha: Mathayo aandĩkaga Magadani, Mariko Dalimanutha (Mark 8:10). Andũ aingĩ moonaga atĩ nĩ Magdala, itũũra rĩa Mũtheru Maria Magidalena, kũrĩa kwonirwo thunagogi ya karine ka mbere.
Bethsaida, north of the Sea of Galilee: Bethisaida, rũgongo rwa Iria rĩa Galili
The home of Peter, Andrew and Philip (Jo: Itũũra rĩa Petero, Anderea na Filipu (John 1:44). Athuthurie a maũndũ ma tene matiiguanĩte gatagatĩ ka Et-Tell na El-Araj, hakuhĩ na harĩa Jorodani ĩtoonyaga iria-inĩ.
Banias, at the foot of Mount Hermon: Banias, magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma kĩa Herimoni
A pagan city at the springs of the Jorda: Itũũra rĩa andũ a ndũrĩrĩ ithima-inĩ cia Jorodani, rungu rwa rũthingo rũnene rwa rwaro. Haha, mbere ya hekarũ cia ngai ya mũhianano Pan, Petero nĩ oimbũrire atĩ Jesũ nĩwe Kristo.
Basilica of the Transfiguration, Mount T: Basilika ya Kũgarũrũka, kĩrĩma kĩa Taboro
The Gospels say \"a high mountain\" (Mar: Ivanjeli ciugaga "kĩrĩma kĩraihu" (Mark 9:2). Kuuma hĩndĩ ya Origen na Mũtheru Cyril wa Jerusalemu, kĩrĩra kiugaga nĩ Taboro; basilika ya Afransiskani nĩ ĩthaithagia kĩongo gĩakĩo.
A town of black basalt in the hills abov: Itũũra rĩa mahiga marĩ meirũ tũrĩma-inĩ igũrũ rĩa Kapernaumu, kũmwe kwa kũrĩa "eekĩte ciama ciake nyingĩ" (Matthew 11:20-21).
The village of Martha, Mary and Lazarus: Itũũra rĩa Maritha, Maria na Lazaro mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ. Kũu, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ maceeragĩra mbĩrĩra ya Lazaro na kanitha wa Afransiskani.
The pool at the south end of the City of: Karia kĩhinga-inĩ gĩa gũthini kĩa Itũũra rĩa Daudi, karĩa kahe maaĩ nĩ mũtaro wa Hezekia. Ngathĩ ciako cia karine ka mbere nĩ cionirwo mwaka wa 2004.
Church of the Pater Noster (Eleona), Mou: Kanitha wa Baba Witũ (Eleona), Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
Saint Helena built the Eleona church ove: Mũtheru Helena nĩ aakire kanitha wa Eleona igũrũ rĩa ngurunga ĩrĩa, kũringana na kĩrĩra, Mwathani witũ aarutaga arutwo ake. Mahooya ma Baba Witũ nĩ mathaithagia thingo ciaguo na mĩario ĩkĩrĩte 140.
John says only that it was a town near t: Johana oigaga o atĩ warĩ itũũra hakuhĩ na werũ (John 11:54). Kĩrĩra nĩ kĩrĩigaga Taybeh, ũmũthĩ itũũra rĩa Akristiano.
The oasis city on the road up to Jerusal: Itũũra rĩa kũndũ kũrĩ maaĩ werũ-inĩ njĩra-inĩ ĩrĩa yambataga Jerusalemu. Mũkũyũ wa mũthikamore itũũra-inĩ nĩ ũtũririkanagia Zakayo.
Franciscan church of Bethphage, Mount of: Kanitha wa Afransiskani wa Bethifage, Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
The village where the disciples found th: Itũũra rĩrĩa arutwo moonire kana ka ndigiri. Mũtũarano wa Kiumia gĩa Mathangũ ma Mĩtende wa Kanitha wa Jerusalemu o na rĩu nĩ wambagĩrĩria kũu o mwaka.
Church of Dominus Flevit, Mount of Olive: Kanitha wa Dominus Flevit ("Mwathani nĩ aarĩrire"), Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
A small church shaped like a teardrop, l: Kanitha mũnini ũhaana ta ithori, ũrorete itũũra mũrĩmo wa gĩtuamba kĩa Kedironi, ũgatũririkania harĩa "Mwathani aarĩrĩire".
The early Church honoured Mount Zion as: Kanitha wa mbere nĩ watĩĩte kĩrĩma kĩa Zayuni ta harĩa Irio cia Hwaĩ-inĩ cia Mũthia na Pentekoste ciekĩkĩire. Nyũmba ya ũmũthĩ ya mũthemba wa Gothic yumĩte hĩndĩ ya Akurusedi na Afransiskani.
Church of All Nations, at the foot of th: Basilika ya Ndũrĩrĩ Ciothe, magũrũ-inĩ ma Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
The garden of ancient olive trees, with: Mũgũnda wa mĩtamaiyũ ya tene, hamwe na Basilika ya Ndũrĩrĩ Ciothe ĩrĩa yakirwo igũrũ rĩa ihiga rĩrĩa Mwathani witũ aahooire arĩ thĩinĩ wa ruo rũnene.
Saint Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion: Mũtheru Petero kũu Gallicantu, Kĩrĩma kĩa Zayuni
The Church of Saint Peter in Gallicantu: Kanitha wa Mũtheru Petero kũu Gallicantu ("rĩrĩa ngũkũ yagĩkũgĩte") nĩ ũtũririkanagia ũrega wa Petero na ũtukũ ũrĩa Mwathani witũ aarĩ njeera. Angĩ nĩ maigaga nyũmba ya mũthĩnjĩri-ngai mũnene hakuhĩ na Cenacolo.
Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Kanitha wa Kũhũũrwo Iboko na Kĩhingo kĩa Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Njĩra ya Mũtharaba yambagĩrĩria Gĩtũũra-inĩ kĩa Ita kĩa Antonia, kũrĩa Afransiskani mamenyagĩrĩra makanitha ma Kũhũũrwo Iboko na ma Gũtuĩrwo Ciira. Athomi aingĩ nĩ maigaga Pilato nyũmba-inĩ ya ũnene ya Herode hakuhĩ na Kĩhingo kĩa Jafa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Njĩra ya Mũtharaba, Itũũra Inene rĩa Tene rĩa Jerusalemu
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Kuuma Matukũ ma Gatagatĩ, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ mahooyagĩra Ihinda cia Njĩra ya Mũtharaba barabara-inĩ ĩno, kuuma Gĩtũũra kĩa Ita kĩa Antonia nginya Kalvari; o Ijumaa Afransiskani nĩ matongoragia mũtũarano. Njĩra ya ma ĩrĩa Mwathani witũ aagererire ĩrũgamĩte harĩa Pilato aamũtuĩrĩire ciira.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Akristiano nĩ matĩĩte kũndũ gũkũ kuuma njiarwa cia mbere; Mũtheru Helena na Konstantino nĩ maakire basilika igũrũ rĩa rwaro rwa Kalvari na mbĩrĩra ĩtarĩ kĩndũ, na ũmũthĩ Afransiskani nĩo matungataga kũu.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka oigaga ũraihu wa stadia mĩrongo ĩtandatũ kuuma Jerusalemu (Luke 24:13). Kũndũ gũtatũ nĩ gũtĩĩtwo: Emmaus Nicopolis, kũrĩa konanĩtio haha; El-Qubeibeh, kũrĩa kũmenyagĩrĩrwo nĩ Afransiskani; na Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Kanitha wa Wĩrugamĩrĩri wa Mũtheru Petero, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Kanitha mũnini wa mahiga marĩ meirũ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia maaĩ, ũrĩa wakirwo ũthiũrũrũkĩirie ihiga rĩĩtagwo "Mensa Christi" (Metha ya Kristo), harĩa, kũringana na kĩrĩra, aarugĩire Atũmwo irio cia rũciinĩ.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Kanitha wa Mbĩrĩra ya Maria, gĩtuamba kĩa Kedironi
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Kuuma karine ka gatano kana mbere ya hĩndĩ ĩyo, Kanitha wa Jerusalemu nĩ ũtĩĩte mbĩrĩra ĩno magũrũ-inĩ ma Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ, hakuhĩ na Gethisemane, ta harĩa Nyina wa Ngai ambatirio igũrũ. Nyũmba ya amonaki ya Gũkoma kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Zayuni nĩ ĩririkanagia gũkoma gwake; kĩrĩra kĩngĩ kiugaga atĩ mĩaka yake ya mũthia aamĩikarire na Mũtheru Johana kũu Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Kanitha Mũnini wa Kwambata Igũrũ, Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka oigaga atĩ nĩ aamatongoririe "nginya Bethania" (Luke 24:50), na Atũmwo ikoigaga atĩ maacookire kuuma Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ (Acts 1:12). Kanitha mũnini kĩongo-inĩ nĩ ũigĩte ihiga rĩrĩa rĩtĩĩtwo ta rĩrĩ na makinya make ma mũthia.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Mũraika Gaburieli nĩ ageithia Mũirĩtu ũrĩa ũiyũrĩtwo nĩ ngatho. Rĩrĩa acookia atĩrĩ "ũreke njĩkwo o ta ũrĩa woiga", Kiugo gĩgatuĩka mũndũ nda-inĩ yake.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria nĩ akuuaga Mwathani witũ kwa mũrũ wa nyina Elizabethi. Johana nĩ athiũkaga nda-inĩ nĩ gĩkeno, Elizabethi amwĩtaga "Nyina wa Mwathani wakwa", na Maria akaina Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Itũũra-inĩ rĩa Daudi, Mwathani witũ aciarũo nĩ Mũirĩtu Theru Maria, akooherwo na nguo agakomio mũharatĩ-inĩ wa kũrĩĩra mahiũ, tondũ matiigana kuona handũ nyũmba-inĩ ya ageni.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Mũraika aanĩrĩra "Mũhonokia, ũrĩa nĩwe Kristo Mwathani", nacio mbũtũ cia igũrũ ikaina "Riiri nĩ ũrĩ wa Ngai kũrĩa igũrũ mũno". Arĩithi mahiũha gũthiĩ gũcaria Kaana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Andũ Oogĩ kuuma irathĩro marũmĩrĩra njata yake, makona Kaana hamwe na Maria nyina, na makamũhe thahabu, ũbumba wa kũnungĩra wega na manemane.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria na Josefu maheana Mwathani Kaana. Simeoni amũkuua moko-inĩ make, amwĩta "ũtheri wa kũmũrĩkĩra ndũrĩrĩ", na eere Maria atĩ rũhiũ rwa njora nĩ rũgaatheeca ngoro yake.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Atanaha mwĩhũgo kĩroto-inĩ, Mũtheru Josefu ookĩra ũtukũ akuua Kaana na nyina makĩthiĩ Misiri, kũraya na guoko kwa Herode, nĩguo kiugo kĩhinge: "Ndetire mũrũ wakwa oime Misiri" (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Herode aarĩkia gũkua, Nyũmba Theru ĩgĩtũũra Nazarethi, na "kaana kau gagĩkũra, gakĩgĩa na hinya, gakĩiyũrwo nĩ ũũgĩ, na ngatho ya Ngai ĩkĩgĩa igũrũ rĩako".
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Arĩ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, aatigwo Jerusalemu thutha wa Pasaka. Mũthenya wa gatatũ, Maria na Josefu mamuona gatagatĩ ka arutani: "Kaĩ mũtooĩ atĩ nĩ kwagĩrĩire nyikare maũndũ-inĩ ma Baba?"
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Ihinda rĩa ta mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ aatũũraga Nazarethi, agĩathĩkĩra Maria na Josefu, akĩruta wĩra wa ũhiũ wa mbaũ, na agĩkũra ũũgĩ-inĩ, ũraihu-inĩ na ngatho-inĩ maitho-inĩ ma Ngai na andũ.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Johana nĩ aamũbatithirie Jorodani. Igũrũ rĩkĩhingũka, Roho Mũtheru agĩikũrũka ta ndutura, nayo mũgambo wa Ithe ũkiuga: "Ũyũ nĩwe Mũrũ wakwa nyendete, ũrĩa ngenagio nĩwe mũno."
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Roho amũtwara werũ-inĩ, kũrĩa eehingire kũrĩa mĩthenya mĩrongo ĩna na ũtukũ mĩrongo ĩna, na agĩtooria magerio ma mũcukani na Kiugo kĩa Ngai.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Johana amũonania: "Onai Gatũrũme ka Ngai." Anderea arehe mũrũ wa nyina Simoni, ũrĩa Jesũ eetire Kefa, ũguo nĩ kuuga Petero; Filipu na Nathanieli mamũrũmĩrĩra.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Nĩ ũndũ wa kiugo kĩa Nyina, "Ĩkai ũndũ wothe ũrĩa arĩmwĩra", agarũra maaĩ magatuĩka ndibei, kĩmenyithia gĩake kĩa mbere, nao arutwo ake makĩambĩrĩria kũmwĩtĩkia.
To Jesus through Mary: Gũkinya kũrĩ Jesũ na njĩra ya Maria
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Pasaka ya mbere: kĩyo nĩ ũndũ wa nyũmba ya Ithe
He drives the money changers from the Te: Aingata agarũri a mbeca kuuma Hekarũ-inĩ na ũtukũ arute Nikodemo atĩ mũndũ no nginya aciarwo rĩngĩ na maaĩ na Roho. "Nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩ eendire thĩ mũno, o nginya akĩheana Mũriũ wake ũrĩa wa mũmwe."
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Aanogete mũthenya barigici, eetia mũtumia Mũsamaria maaĩ ma kũnyua, nake amũhe maaĩ ma muoyo, "gĩthima kĩa maaĩ maratherera nginya muoyo wa tene na tene". Aingĩ a itũũra rĩake mamwĩtĩkia.
Healing the Official's Son: Kũhonia mũriũ wa mũnene wa mũthamaki
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Mũnene ũmwe wa mũthamaki kuuma Kapernaumu amũthaitha oke. "Thiĩ, mũrũguo nĩ muoyo." Ihinda-inĩ o rĩu kaana gakĩhona.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Thunagogi-inĩ athoma ibuku-inĩ rĩa Isaia, "Roho wa Mwathani arĩ igũrũ rĩakwa", na akiuga: "Ũmũthĩ Maandĩko macio nĩ mahingĩte." Andũ a itũũra rĩake mamũtwara hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia kĩrĩma, no agĩtuĩkanĩria gatagatĩ-inĩ kao agĩthiĩ.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Afransiskani nĩ matĩĩte Kĩrĩma kĩa Gũthiũka gũthini wa itũũra ta kĩrĩma kĩrĩa kiugĩtwo thĩinĩ wa Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Aarĩkia kuuma Nazarethi, atũũra Kapernaumu hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria, na akĩambĩrĩria kũhunjia: "Ihinda nĩ rĩkinyĩte, Ũthamaki wa Ngai nĩ ũkuhĩrĩirie. Ĩrirai na mwĩtĩkie Ivanjeli."
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Hũgũrũrũ-inĩ eeta Simoni na Anderea, Jakubu na Johana: "Nũmĩrĩrai, na nĩngũmũtua ategi a andũ." Thutha wa kũgũra thamaki na njĩra ya kĩama, matiga maũndũ mothe makamũrũmĩrĩra.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Arutana na ũhoti thunagogi-inĩ, aingata ngoma thĩinĩ wa mũndũ, arũgamia nyina wa mũtumia wa Petero kuuma mũrimũ-inĩ wa mwĩrũgũtho, na rĩrĩa riũa rĩathũa itũũra rĩothe rĩcemania mũromo-inĩ wa nyũmba.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Mũndũ mũkue mwĩrĩ na gwĩtwo kwa Mathayo
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Arata mekũrũkia mũndũ mũkue mwĩrĩ na njĩra ya nyũmba igũrũ; Jesũ amũrekere mehia make na amwathe athiĩ. Thutha ũcio eeta Lawi, Mathayo, harĩa ookanagĩrĩrio igooti: "Nũmĩrĩra."
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Arute Irathimo, "Kũrathimwo nĩ arĩa athĩĩni roho-inĩ, tondũ Ũthamaki wa igũrũ nĩ wao", watho mwerũ wa wendo, na mahooya ma Baba Witũ.
The Centurion's Servant: Ndungata ya mũnene wa thigari igana
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Mũnene wa thigari igana Mũroma oiga atĩrĩ: "Mwathani, ndiagĩrĩirwo nĩ atĩ ũtoonye nyũmba yakwa, no ugo o kiugo kĩmwe." Kanitha nĩ ũcookagia ciugo ciake mbere ya kwamũkĩra Ũkaristia o Misa-inĩ.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Amũiguĩra tha mũtumia wa ndigwa ũrĩa warĩ gũthika mũriũ wake ũrĩa wa mũmwe, ahutia gĩtanda gĩa kĩimba: "Mwanake, ndakwĩra atĩrĩ, ũkĩra!" na akamũcookeria nyina.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Kĩathĩ-inĩ kĩmwe Jerusalemu nĩ aahonirie mũndũ warĩ mũrũaru mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ĩnana: "Ũkĩra, ũkuue kĩrĩrĩ gĩaku, ũthiĩ."
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene kĩiyũria gĩtarũrũ maaĩ, nake akomete. Akaania rũhuho: "Kira! Hoorera!" na gũkĩgĩa na ũhooreri mũnene. "Ũyũ nĩ ũ, atĩ o na rũhuho na iria nĩ imwathĩkagĩra?"
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Mũrĩmo ũcio ũngĩ ahonia mũndũ warĩ na thĩĩna nĩ ũndũ wa ngoma nyingĩ, iria cietwo irũũru-inĩ rĩa nguruwe. Mũndũ ũcio amũthaitha amũrũmĩrĩre, no atũmwo agathiĩ kwanĩrĩra ũrĩa Mwathani amwĩkĩire.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Mũtumia ũmwe ahona rĩrĩa ahutia nguo yake, nake anyiita guoko kwa mũirĩtu wa Jairo ũrĩa wakuĩte: "Talitha kumi", ũguo nĩ kuuga: "Kairĩtu, ndakwĩra atĩrĩ, ũkĩra!"
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Na mĩgate ĩtano na thamaki igĩrĩ arĩithia kĩrĩndĩ, aroraga igũrũ, agacookia ngaatho na akoinanga mĩgate, nao makĩũngania ikabũ ikũmi na igĩrĩ iyũrĩte tũcunjĩ tũrĩa twatigarire.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Ihinda-inĩ rĩa mũthia rĩa ũtukũ ookire kũrĩ o agĩthiĩ igũrũ rĩa iria. Petero athiĩ kũmũtũnga, aambĩrĩria kũrũũra na akaanĩrĩra: "Mwathani, honokia!"
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Thunagogi-inĩ ya Kapernaumu arute: "Niĩ nĩ niĩ mũgate wa muoyo… Ũrĩa ũrĩĩaga mwĩrĩ wakwa na akanyua thakame yakwa arĩ na muoyo wa tene na tene." Petero acookia: "Mwathani, tũgũthiĩ kũrĩ ũ?"
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Nyina ũmwe wa ndũrĩrĩ amũthaitha nĩ ũndũ wa mwarĩ: "O na ngui nĩ irĩĩaga tũcunjĩ tũrĩa tũgũaga kuuma metha-inĩ ya aathani ao." "Mũtumia, wĩtĩkio waku nĩ mũnene!"
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Ahingũra matũ ma mũndũ mũkiga, "Efatha", ũguo nĩ kuuga "Hingũka!", na na mĩgate mũgwanja arĩithia ngiri inya iria ciaikarĩte nake mĩthenya ĩtatũ.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Afarisai na Asadukai mamũũria kĩmenyithia kuuma igũrũ. Amera atĩ matikũheo kĩmenyithia kĩngĩ tiga kĩmenyithia kĩa Jona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Anyiita mũtumumu guoko, amũtwara nja ya itũũra, na akamũigĩrĩra moko maita meerĩ, nginya akĩona maũndũ mothe wega.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: "No inyuĩ, mũugaga niĩ nĩ niĩ ũ?" Petero acookia: "Wee nĩwe Kristo, Mũrũ wa Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo." "Wee ũrĩ Petero, na igũrũ rĩa rwaro rũrũ nĩ ngaaka Kanitha wakwa… Nĩngakũhe ndũrũgĩ cia Ũthamaki wa igũrũ."
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Mbere ya Petero, Jakubu na Johana, ũthiũ wake ũkenya ta riũa, Musa na Elija maaria nake, nake Ithe akiuga: "Ũyũ nĩwe Mũrũ wakwa nyendete… Mũthikĩrĩriei."
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Akaania matũũra marĩa eekĩte ciama ciake nyingĩ, Korazini, Bethisaida na Kapernaumu, tondũ matiigana kwĩrira.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petero oona igooti rĩa Hekarũ kanua-inĩ ka thamaki. Thutha ũcio Jesũ arũgamia kaana gatagatĩ-inĩ kao: "Mũtangĩgarũrũka mũtuĩke ta twana tũnini, mũtingĩtoonya Ũthamaki-inĩ wa igũrũ."
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Nja-inĩ cia Hekarũ arute: "Mũndũ angĩkorwo arĩ na nyota, nĩoke kũrĩ niĩ anyue", arekere mũtumia ũrĩa wanyiitwo agĩtharia, "Thiĩ, na kuuma rĩu ndũkanehie rĩngĩ", na anĩrĩra: "Niĩ nĩ niĩ ũtheri wa thĩ."
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Ahaka mũndũ waciarirwo arĩ mũtumumu ndoro maitho-inĩ, amũtũma athiĩ akeethambe karia-inĩ ka Siloamu. Acooka akĩona na akamũhooya: "Mwathani, nĩ ndĩtĩkĩtie."
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Maritha amwamũkĩra, nake Maria aikara magũrũ-inĩ make agĩthikĩrĩria. "Maria nĩ athuurĩte gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩa kĩega, na gĩtikamũrutwo."

Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Athiĩ kĩhumbĩro-inĩ kĩa Solomoni hĩndĩ ya heho, na akiuga: "Ng'ondu ciakwa nĩ iguaga mũgambo wakwa… Niĩ na Baba tũrĩ ũmwe."

As the council plots His death, He withd: Rĩrĩa Kĩama Kĩnene gĩathugundire kũmũũraga, eehitha hamwe na arutwo ake itũũra-inĩ rĩrĩ hakuhĩ na werũ rĩĩtagwo Efiraimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Mũtumumu Baritimayo anĩrĩra: "Jesũ, Mũrũ wa Daudi, njiguĩra tha!" na akĩona. Zakayo ambata mũkũyũ wa mũthikamore nĩguo amuone: "Ũmũthĩ ũhonokio nĩ ũkinyĩte nyũmba ĩno."
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Mĩthenya ĩtandatũ mbere ya Pasaka, Maria aitĩrĩria magũrũ make maguta ma narido manungi wega ma goro mũnene, nayo nyũmba ĩkĩiyũrwo nĩ mũtararĩko. Amũkĩra ũndũ ũcio ta gũitĩrĩrio maguta nĩ ũndũ wa gũthikwo gwake.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Atoonya Jerusalemu ahaicĩte kana ka ndigiri rĩrĩa kĩrĩndĩ kĩratambũrũkia nguo na honge: "Hosana kũrĩ Mũrũ wa Daudi! Nĩ mũrathime ũrĩa ũrooka na rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani!"
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Rĩrĩa oona itũũra, arĩrĩra: "Naarĩ korwo o na wee nĩ ũmenyete ũmũthĩ maũndũ marĩa magũkũrehera thayũ!"
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Ahĩndũra metha, "Nyũmba yakwa ĩgeetagwo nyũmba ya mahooya ya ndũrĩrĩ ciothe", na agathĩrĩria mũtumia wa ndigwa mũthĩĩni ũrĩa waheanire mbeca ciake igĩrĩ nini cia mũthia.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Aikarĩte Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ arorete Hekarũ, aaria ũhoro wa kwanangwo kwayo na ũhoro wa gũũka gwake arĩ na riiri: "Ũrĩa mwekire ũmwe wa ariũ a baba aya anini mũno, mwekire niĩ."
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Athambia magũrũ ma arutwo ake na, akĩoya mũgate na ndibei, akiuga: "Ũyũ nĩ mwĩrĩ wakwa… Gĩkombe gĩkĩ nĩ kĩrĩkanĩro kĩerũ thakame-inĩ yakwa… Ĩkagai ũguo nĩ ũndũ wa kũndirikana"; nĩ ũndũ ũcio aahe Kanitha Ũkaristia na ũthĩnjĩri-ngai.
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Arĩ thĩinĩ wa ruo rũnene ahooya, nayo ithithino rĩake rĩgatuĩka ta matone ma thakame: "Baba… no ti ta ũrĩa niĩ nyendaga, no ta ũrĩa wee wendaga." Judasi oka na kĩrĩndĩ na akamũkunyanĩra na kĩmumunyo.

\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: "Hĩndĩ ĩyo Pilato akĩoya Jesũ akĩmũhũũrithia iboko." "Nĩ ũndũ wa ironda ciake nĩ tũhonetio" (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Thigari ciohe thũmbĩ ya mĩigua, ikamwĩhumbia nguo ya rangi wa ndathi na ikamũthekerera: "Ũhoro waku, Mũthamaki wa Ayahudi!" Pilato amũruta nja: "Onai mũndũ ũyũ!" na akamũneana nĩguo aambwo mũtharaba-inĩ.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Akuuĩte mũtharaba wake, oima agĩthiĩ Kalvari. Simoni wa Kurene ahatwo amũteithie, nake eera atumia arĩa maararĩra: "Inyuĩ airĩtu a Jerusalemu, mũtikandĩrĩre, no mwĩrĩrei inyuĩ ene na ciana cianyu."
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Aambwo mũtharaba-inĩ gatagatĩ ka eehia eerĩ. "Baba, marekere, tondũ matiũĩ ũrĩa mareeka." "Ũmũthĩ ũkũgĩa hamwe na niĩ paradiso." "Mũtumia, ũcio nĩ mũrũguo… Ũcio nĩ nyũkwa." "Nĩ kũrĩkĩte." Ainamia mũtwe na akaneana roho wake.

Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Josefu wa Arimathaia na Nikodemo mooha mwĩrĩ wake na nguo cia gatani hamwe na mũtararĩko, na makamũiga mbĩrĩra-inĩ njerũ ĩrĩa yenjĩtwo ihiga-inĩ, mũgũnda-inĩ hakuhĩ na harĩa aambĩirwo.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Mũthenya wa mbere wa kiumia, mbĩrĩra ĩtirĩ kĩndũ. Mwathani ũrĩa ũriũkĩte eeta Maria Magidalena na rĩĩtwa rĩake na akamũtũma kũrĩ Atũmwo: "Nĩnyonete Mwathani."
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Matamũmenyete, athiĩ na arutwo eerĩ na akamataarĩria Maandĩko, nao makamũmenya rĩrĩa oinanga mũgate. "Githĩ ngoro citũ ndiahĩaga thĩinĩ witũ?"
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Mĩrango ĩhingĩtwo, arũgama gatagatĩ ka Atũmwo na akamahuhĩra: "Amũkĩrai Roho Mũtheru. Arĩa mũkaarekera mehia, nĩ makaarekerwo", na thutha wa kiumia kĩmwe Thoma oimbũra: "Mwathani wakwa na Ngai wakwa!"
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Rũciinĩ tene iria-inĩ aiyũria neti ciao na akamarugĩra irio cia rũciinĩ. Oria Petero maita matatũ: "Nĩ ũnyendete?" na maita matatũ akamũnengera wĩra: "Rĩithia ng'ondu ciakwa."
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩmwe kũu Galili atũma Ikũmi na Ũmwe: "Nĩ ũndũ ũcio thiĩi mũtue ndũrĩrĩ ciothe arutwo, mũcibatithagie thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Ithe, na rĩa Mũrũ, na rĩa Roho Mũtheru… Na ningĩ, menyai, ndĩ hamwe na inyuĩ matukũ mothe nginya mũthia wa thĩ."
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Mathayo ndagweta rĩĩtwa rĩa kĩrĩma. Ageni a gũthathaiya kaingĩ maririkanaga ũndũ ũcio Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Irathimo; angĩ meciragia nĩ Taboro kana kĩrĩma kĩa Arbel.

Petero ahunjia Kristo ũrĩa wambirwo mũtharaba-inĩ na akĩriũka, andũ ta ngiri ithatũ mabatithio, nakĩo Kanitha gĩgĩthiĩ ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ ciothe.

At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Rĩrĩa mũtũũrĩre wake wa gũkũ thĩ wathirire, Nyina wa Ngai ũtarĩ na Mehia ma Kũgĩa, Maria Mũirĩtu Theru hĩndĩ ciothe, nĩ ambatirio riiri-inĩ wa igũrũ arĩ na mwĩrĩ na roho, o ta ũrĩa Papa Pio XII aanĩrĩire mwaka wa 1950. Ũrĩa waciarire Mwathani nĩwe wa mbere kũgaana kũriũka kwa Mũriũ wake.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Maandĩko matigwetaga kũndũ. Konanĩtio mbĩrĩra-inĩ kũrĩa Kanitha wa Jerusalemu ũkũũgagĩra kwambatio gwake kuuma tene.

"Na kĩmenyithia kĩnene gĩkĩoneka igũrũ: mũtumia ehumbĩte riũa, mweri ũrĩ rungu rwa magũrũ make, na mũtwe-inĩ wake thũmbĩ ya njata ikũmi na igĩrĩ."

The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rosari yaciarirwo mahooya-inĩ ma Kanitha. Amonaki maainaga Thaburi 150, nao Akristiano arĩa matooĩ gũthoma makĩhooya Baba Witũ 150, thutha ũcio Nĩngũkũgeithia Maria 150, makĩmatara rũrigi-inĩ rwa tũhiga: "Thaburi cia Maria".
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Kũringana na kĩrĩra kĩrĩa kĩendetwo, Mũirĩtu Theru Maria nĩ aaheire Mũtheru Dominiko Rosari kũu Prouille, Bũrũri wa Fransa, kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ gĩa karine ka 13, nĩguo ĩmũteithie ũhunjia-inĩ wake wa gũũkĩrĩra ũrutani wa maheeni wa Aalbigensia. Mbũtũ yake, Mbũtũ ya Ahunjia, nĩ yamĩhurunjirie thĩ yothe ya Akristiano, na karine ka 15 Mũrathimĩtwo Alano wa La Roche, Mũdominika, nĩ aacookirie ũtĩi ũyũ wĩrũ na akĩambĩrĩria ngwatanĩro cia mbere cia Rosari.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mũtheru Papa Pio V, o nake Mũdominika, nĩ aaheire Rosari mũhianĩre wayo wa hĩndĩ ciothe wa maũndũ ma hitho ikũmi na ithano, ma Gĩkeno, ma Ruo na ma Riiri, mwaka wa 1569. Thutha wa ũhootani wa Lepanto mũthenya wa 7 mweri wa Ikũmi 1571, ũrĩa woneka rĩrĩa thĩ yothe ya Akristiano yahooyaga Rosari, nĩ aatuire mũthenya ũcio gĩathĩ kĩa Maria wa Ũhootani, ũmũthĩ kĩririkano kĩa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria wa Rosari. Kũu Lourdes na Fatima, Mũirĩtu Theru we mwene ookire na rosari na akĩũria ĩhooyagwo o mũthenya.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Mũthenya wa 16 mweri wa Ikũmi 2002, Mũtheru Papa Johana Paulo II nĩ ongereire maũndũ ma hitho matano ma Ũtheri, kuuma mũtũũrĩre-inĩ wa Mwathani witũ wa kĩrĩndĩ-inĩ, marũa-inĩ make ma atũmwo Rosarium Virginis Mariae, nĩguo Rosari ĩtuĩke "ũhoro mũkuhĩ wa Ivanjeli".
